items.subject: New sign-in to your OpenAI account
items.summary: OpenAI reported a sign-in from Chrome Mobile on Android in London at 16:27 BST.
items.action: Confirm whether this sign-in was yours. If not, secure the OpenAI account immediately using a trusted route.
items.decisionNeeded: Confirm whether the OpenAI sign-in was expected

items.subject: Security alert
items.summary: Google reported a Windows sign-in and, earlier in the same thread, that OpenAI was granted access to selected Google Account data.
items.action: Confirm both activities were expected. If either was not, review Google Account security through a trusted route.
items.decisionNeeded: Confirm the Windows sign-in and OpenAI account access

items.subject: Something's changed... and your CV is no longer the whole story.
items.summary: A recruitment marketing email promoting an expanded candidate profile intended to show experience beyond a standard CV.
items.action: No action required unless you want to update your Morgan Hunt candidate profile.
